result.summary:
All checks on one uploaded file are now in `file_ensure_uploaded( array $p_file )` in core/file_api.php. It runs the 9 checks in the order you gave, with your messages, and keeps the old error codes (ERROR_FILE_NO_UPLOAD_FAILURE, ERROR_FILE_TOO_BIG, ERROR_FILE_NAME_TOO_LONG, ERROR_FILE_NOT_ALLOWED, ERROR_UPLOAD_FAILURE). A file array without an `error` key passes.

These call it: `file_add()` (first thing it does), IssueAddCommand, IssueFileAddCommand and IssueNoteAddCommand (for each file, during validation, after the access and moderation checks, so a bad file stops the command before any issue, note or file is saved), and proj_doc_update.php. The XmlImportExport import page already called it. I removed the duplicated checks from `file_add()`, IssueAddCommand and proj_doc_update.php.

Other changes, which you may want to look at:
1. New helper `file_filter_not_selected()`. A web form with an empty file input sends an entry with an empty name and UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE. `file_attach_files()` always skipped these. The commands now remove them before the checks, so an empty input does not fail with 'File name is empty'.
2. proj_doc_update.php used to skip a file silently when the upload failed (for example a file that was too big), and saved only the title. Now it runs the checks whenever a file was sent, and it still requires `is_uploaded_file()`. It now also checks the file type, which it did not do before.
3. ERROR_FILE_NAME_TOO_LONG had no HTTP status, so REST returned 500 for it (before this change too). I mapped it to 400 in core/error_api.php.

`composer run check-fast` passes. `composer run check` passes: 760 tests, 2674 assertions. Note that `composer run check` dropped and reinstalled the local test database.

changes.summary: Rewrote file_ensure_uploaded() with the 9 ordered checks; file_add() calls it first and no longer has its own name length, type, antispam, empty file and size checks; added file_filter_not_selected().
Replaced the inline name length check with file_filter_not_selected() and file_ensure_uploaded() for each file during validation.
Requires file_api.php, removes empty web inputs in parseFiles(), calls file_ensure_uploaded() for each file at the end of validate().
Requires file_api.php, removes empty web inputs in parseFiles(), calls file_ensure_uploaded() for each file after the access and moderation checks in validate().
Removed the duplicated name length and size checks; web server upload errors are no longer skipped silently; is_uploaded_file() is still required.
ERROR_FILE_NAME_TOO_LONG now maps to HTTP 400 instead of 500.

New tests: each check and its message and code, the order of the checks (antispam first, name, upload error before length, length before type, type before path), empty file, maximum size, a file without an error key, file_filter_not_selected(), IssueFileAddCommand and IssueNoteAddCommand stop before saving anything, file_add() runs the checks.
New tests: creating an issue with a file type that is not allowed, an empty file, an empty name or a name that is too long gives 400; a valid file is attached.
New test: a note with a file type that is not allowed gives 400, and no note or file is added.
Log entry: what changed, what I learned, what is left (SOAP).

acceptance.criterion: Every upload path uses this one function with the checks above
acceptance.evidence: file_add() calls file_ensure_uploaded() first, and file_attach_files(), proj_doc_add.php and the XML import go through file_add(). IssueAddCommand, IssueFileAddCommand and IssueNoteAddCommand call it for each file during validate(). proj_doc_update.php and XmlImportExport import_action.php call it directly. The duplicated checks were removed. One exception: SOAP mci_file_add() writes the content itself and does not use file_add(), so it keeps its own type and size checks (see human_needed).

acceptance.criterion: The change is covered by tests
acceptance.evidence: tests/Mantis/FileEnsureUploadedTest.php covers every check, the messages, the error codes, the order of the checks and the three commands. New REST tests: RestIssueTest::testCreateIssueWithInvalidFiles, testCreateIssueWithFile and RestIssueNotesTest::testAddNoteWithInvalidAttachment. All pass in composer run check.

acceptance.criterion: The existing test suite still passes
acceptance.evidence: composer run check-fast: lint, OpenAPI lint and 22 unit tests pass. composer run check: OK (760 tests, 2674 assertions), exit code 0.

human_needed.question: Should SOAP mci_file_add() (api/soap/mc_file_api.php) also call file_ensure_uploaded(), for example by writing the content to a temporary file first?
human_needed.why: It does not use file_add() and has its own type and size checks with different fault responses (403 and 400). Changing it would change the SOAP API behaviour, so I left it as it is.

human_needed.question: Is it acceptable that an empty file input from a web form (empty name and UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) is ignored and not reported as 'File name is empty'?
human_needed.why: The task says an empty name must fail. But web forms send such entries when no file is selected, and file_attach_files() always ignored them. Rejecting them would break issue reporting and note adding without attachments. A file with an empty name from the API is still rejected.

harness_used: AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md: conventions, the fast and full gates, the rule to add a log entry

docs/local-dev.md: how the integration suites need the installed instance and web server
composer run check-fast and composer run check (build/local_instance.sh): reinstalled MySQL and ran all 760 tests

harness_gaps.problem: There is no helper to log in as another user, or to build a command that needs the SOAP mci_* helpers (IssueAddCommand). That is why IssueAddCommand is tested through REST only.

It does not say that a REST response of 500 often means that an error code is missing in error_map_api_error_to_http_status(), or where the PHP built-in server log is (the gate prints the path in a temp folder).
No unit-level (no database) test is possible for file_api.php because it needs core.php, so the fast gate does not cover this change. Only the full gate does.
